name: ASM-021 small thermal printer feed module benchmark
description: Intermediate hierarchical CAD assembly benchmark for a compact thermal printer feed module with chassis, side plates, rollers, paper roll/strip, printhead, heat-sink fins, gear train, sensors, and screws.

tasks.prompt: Create a small thermal printer paper-feed module assembly with a chassis, side plates, rubber platen and pinch rollers, paper roll, paper strip through the feed path, printhead bar, repeated heat-sink fins, drive gears with simple teeth, paper sensor flags, and repeated chassis screws. Keep the assembly visually recognizable as a compact receipt printer feed mechanism.
assumptions: Intermediate assembly benchmark covers a readable consumer/electronics mechanism with paper feed, roller, printhead, and drive train cues.
Repeated components are functional: screws, fins, gear teeth, side plates, rollers, and sensor flags.
Generated STEP, GLB, topology, and component artifacts are produced by the CAD pipeline and are not hand-edited source of truth.
